candidates.tagline: Two boxing legends finally fight — the poster promotes 'U vs J'
candidates.story: The official promotional poster for Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua, unveiled September 26, 2026, stacked 'Fury' and 'AJ' vertically alongside 'Finally' in a layout that reads unmistakably as 'Finally U vs J' — promptly awarded an F grade by designers and fans.
candidates.why_funny: After years of negotiations to get two boxing legends in the same ring, the poster accidentally promoted a fight between two people named U and J.
candidates.alt: Official Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua promotional boxing poster with 'Finally', 'Fury' and 'AJ' arranged vertically so the layout reads as 'Finally U vs J'

candidates.tagline: Ontario spent millions building bike lanes. Now paying millions to un-build them.
candidates.story: Ontario Premier Doug Ford issued a 110-page request for proposals on September 28, 2026, to remove 19 kilometres of protected bike lanes from Toronto's busiest streets — with bids due November 2026 and a first milestone deadline of April 1, 2027.
candidates.why_funny: The government answered demands to keep the pandemic-era lanes by formally contracting to dig up the same streets all over again, then scheduled the 'alternative routes' deadline on April Fools' Day.
candidates.alt: Protected bike lane with green painted markings on Bloor Street in Toronto, with cyclists riding in the dedicated lane alongside parked cars
